description: None of the three -cli.sh launchers wrap the spawned claude session in an execution timeout (e.g. `timeout Ns claude ...`). If a sub-tool the session calls (CloakBrowser interaction, CAPTCHA solve, an OTP wait, a network call) hangs indefinitely mid-task, there is no forced kill; the only backstop is the same 26-hour staleness window used for crash detection.
concreteFailureScenario: STEP2 of the capafy pass calls CloakBrowser at :9222 to clone a competitor listing; the CDP connection stalls waiting on a page that never loads. The claude turn never completes, the tmux pane sits blocked, .capafy-loop-last-pass is never touched, and no external process kills or retries it for up to 26 hours.
